# Subway Seat for Rio

Normal, light and dim colors, both cursors, tabs, splits, selection, search and hints.

[Rio](https://rioterm.com) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/rio/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only rio
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

| London Moquette | [`london-moquette.toml`](london-moquette.toml) | `~/.config/rio/themes/london-moquette.toml` |
| London Deep Level | [`london-deep-level.toml`](london-deep-level.toml) | `~/.config/rio/themes/london-deep-level.toml` |
| London Portland | [`london-portland.toml`](london-portland.toml) | `~/.config/rio/themes/london-portland.toml` |
| Paris Guimard | [`paris-guimard.toml`](paris-guimard.toml) | `~/.config/rio/themes/paris-guimard.toml` |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "subway-seat"
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-tunnel"
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "subway-seat-enamel"
```

**London Moquette**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "london-moquette"
```

**London Deep Level**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "london-deep-level"
```

**London Portland**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "london-portland"
```

**Paris Guimard**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "paris-guimard"
```

**Paris Catacombes**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "paris-catacombes"
```

**Paris Carrelage**, in ~/.config/rio/config.toml, at the top level (above any [section]):

```toml
theme = "paris-carrelage"
```

## Follow light and dark

In ~/.config/rio/config.toml:

```toml
[adaptive-theme]
light = "subway-seat-enamel"
dark = "subway-seat"
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/subway-seat.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/subway-seat-tunnel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/subway-seat-enamel.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/london-moquette.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/london-deep-level.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/london-portland.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/paris-guimard.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/paris-catacombes.toml`.
- Delete `~/.config/rio/themes/paris-carrelage.toml`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.
